description: Where a named place is — a park, school, hospital, institution, shop, street or quarter in Plovdiv or Sofia: from Nishka's own data first (official and curated lists, Основа, OpenStreetMap), then the map service. Returns each match with its kind, address or district, its point and the source; several matches when the name is shared (ask the person which one). Latin or Cyrillic spellings both work (Ribnitsa = Рибница).

name.description: The place's name, e.g. „парк Рибница“, „УМБАЛ Свети Георги“, „Mall Plovdiv“.

name: find_place

citations.description: Every source the result rests on. Cite url; give checkedOn or publishedOn.
